Section headers

An optional <header> above a <lay-out> grid, wrapped in a <lay-out-group>. The header lives inside the (optionally themed / full-bleed) box but outside the grid — so the grid engine is untouched and this works over every layout pattern. The header parts reuse the data-part vocabulary.

Row alignment — <lay-out subgrid="3">

The subgrid(on) token in a breakpoint attribute enables it from that breakpoint up (never on stacked small screens); the row count comes from the subgrid="N" attribute. Each card's three rows (image · title · meta) share tracks, so images and meta lines stay aligned even when titles wrap to different lengths. subgrid(off) at a larger breakpoint switches it back off — here it's on from md and off again from xl, so cards realign at medium widths and return to their own heights on wide screens. Works on any direct child with N rows of content (here plain <article>s).
